best_for: People who keep many chat, mail and web apps open all day on Windows or Mac and want them in one window, either within the free plan's one active session or with Pro.
description:
Rambox is a desktop app from Rambox LLC that gathers your web apps and accounts, such as Gmail, Slack, Jira or Notion, into one window. Rambox says more than 80,000 people at about 5,000 companies use it.

The main trick is running the same app more than once with different logins: work Gmail, personal Gmail and a client's Gmail open side by side, with no logging out and back in. You can open tabs inside an app and come back to where you left off. One search bar looks across apps like Slack, Jira, Notion, GitHub and Google Drive at once, and you can mute alerts or hide apps you are not using to cut distractions.

points.title: Free, with a short leash
points.text: The free Basic plan allows unlimited apps, up to 2 instances of each, 2 custom web apps, notifications, focus mode and hibernation, but only 1 active session. Workspaces are a Pro feature.

points.title: Pro is USD 7 a month
points.text: Pro lists at USD 7 per month, or USD 70 per year, and lifts the app limits and allows 3 active sessions. Rambox for Teams is USD 14 per user per month and starts at 5 users. Prices were read on the date below.

points.title: Trial, then back to Basic
points.text: New accounts start with a 30-day Pro trial and no credit card. If you don't pay when it ends, the account drops to Basic.

points.title: Account for sync, not passwords
points.text: Logging in syncs your apps, workspaces and settings across computers. Rambox says it does not store your app logins on its servers and suggests a password manager.

points.title: Closed source
points.text: Rambox is proprietary software from Rambox LLC, so you can't audit or build it yourself.

points.title: Linux missing here
points.text: Rambox says it runs on Linux, but this site lists only Windows and macOS. Windows gets a 64-bit installer and the listing keeps 61 versions; macOS gets a universal zip for macOS 13 or later, current release only.
